title: Prepare package metadata and final open-source release readiness pass
verifyCommands: node -e "const p=require('./package.json'); if(p.private!==true) throw new Error('private true must remain'); if(p.bin||p.publishConfig) throw new Error('bin/publishConfig must remain deferred'); if(p.description==='Personal Codex development harness') throw new Error('description still personal'); if(p.license!=='MIT') throw new Error('license must be MIT'); if(!p.repository||!p.bugs||!p.homepage||!p.engines||!Array.isArray(p.files)) throw new Error('missing public metadata/files boundary');"

node -e "const fs=require('fs'); const files=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('/tmp/samantha-package-dry-run.json','utf8'))[0].files.map(f=>f.path); const banned=[/^runs\//,/^worktrees\//,/^\.samantha-worktrees\//,/^\.samantha-demo\//,/^references\/thread-control\//,/^references\/tasks\//,/^references\/lessons\//]; const bad=files.filter(f=>banned.some(r=>r.test(f))); if(bad.length) throw new Error('banned package files: '+bad.join(',')); const required=['package.json','README.md','LICENSE','CONTRIBUTING.md','SECURITY.md','CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md','src/cli.ts','examples/first-run-demo/fixture-repo/README.md']; const missing=required.filter(f=>!files.includes(f)); if(missing.length) throw new Error('missing package files: '+missing.join(',')); console.log(files.join('\n'));"
rg -n "no package publishing|clone-only|private: true remains|not ready|ready" references/operations/open-source-package-readiness-final-pass.md
instructions: Complete the safe combined scope for open-source remaining plan items 2-4. Read package.json, README.md, LICENSE, CONTRIBUTING.md, SECURITY.md, CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md, references/initiatives/open-source-readiness.md, references/operations/open-source-public-release-checklist.md, references/operations/open-source-governance-package-readiness.md, references/operations/open-source-artifact-map.md, and references/operations/open-source-first-run-demo-dogfood.md. Update package.json only for public-facing metadata and package contents hygiene: replace the personal description with a public-facing local-harness/trust-loop description; add license MIT; add repository, bugs, homepage, keywords, engines for Bun, and a conservative files array. The files array should support future package dry-run verification while excluding dogfood/private evidence by default. Keep private: true. Do not add bin, publishConfig, package runner claims, npm/bunx/npx claims, scripts, dependencies, or version changes. Do not modify bun.lock or bun.lockb. Update references/initiatives/open-source-readiness.md so S6 is completed with governance files commit 17d6349 and the current remaining boundary is package-publication/repo-visibility follow-up, not governance decision debt. Update references/operations/open-source-public-release-checklist.md and references/operations/open-source-governance-package-readiness.md to reflect that governance files exist, package metadata is clone-only/public-facing, private: true remains intentionally, publishConfig/bin/package publishing remain deferred, and references/thread-control/** is excluded from package contents by default. Create references/operations/open-source-package-readiness-final-pass.md as the final readiness pass report for this scope. The report must summarize package metadata changes, package dry-run evidence, excluded dogfood/private surfaces, remaining blockers, and next action. It must be honest: if package publication is still not claimed because private: true, bin, publishConfig, registry availability, or release visibility are deferred, say so. Keep first release clone-only unless a later task explicitly changes package publication posture. Do not edit README.md, source, tests, examples, GitHub templates, top-level governance files, run logs, worktrees, generated state, task specs, task templates, agent profiles, playbooks, lessons, or artifact locations. Do not remove private: true. Do not publish a package. Do not change GitHub repository visibility. Do not promote references/thread-control/** into public onboarding. Do not run demo:first-run from inside the worker because workers must not spawn nested workers; cite accepted demo evidence instead. If honest completion requires package publishing, private: true removal, bin/publishConfig implementation, README rewrite, source changes, artifact movement/deletion, or GitHub repo visibility changes, stop and report the blocker instead of editing those surfaces. End with exactly one HARNESS_RESULT line.
